trailhead.label: car park P 7 on the south shore at Techendorf, the board’s start (Nordic Walking centre “Süd”)

cautions: About 80 m on the lakeside road (L7a) at Techendorf, signed 30 km/h: keep your dog close.
Forest tracks open to forestry vehicles.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
